name: Henrik Kristensen
bio:
Henrik's career began not on the track, but in the Danish military police, where he honed his skills in security and risk assessment. After a decade of service, a chance encounter with a motorsport team during a security detail at a local race ignited a passion he never knew he had. He transitioned into motorsport security, starting at smaller racing events before working his way up to the international stage.

His approach is methodical and detail-oriented, focusing on preventative measures and thorough planning. Henrik believes that a robust security plan is not just about reacting to threats but anticipating them, ensuring the safety and integrity of the team and its assets. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to quickly assess and resolve complex security challenges.

What sets Henrik apart is his blend of military precision and motorsport understanding. He doesn't just see risks; he sees opportunities to enhance security protocols while minimizing disruption to the team's performance. He is valued for his unwavering commitment to protecting the team's interests and creating a secure environment for success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: Henrik is a solidly built man with a calm, watchful presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting security observations.
Has a habit of straightening objects on desks, even in other people's workspaces.
Prefers to communicate via concise bullet points, even in casual conversations.
